# treams-rs

> Private T-matrix scattering package, version 0.1.0. Rust numerics and analytic first-order pullbacks; typed Python interface.

Read these Markdown files at the same Git revision. No public documentation service is required.
With only an installed wheel, run `python -m treams_rs` for a runnable quickstart,
`python -m treams_rs sphere_tmatrix` for one contract, or `--search TEXT` to find names.
Use `--format json` or `--format markdown` for the complete source-derived catalog.
`treams_rs.support_catalog()` never imports optional frameworks.
